title: Cross-platform transcriptomic analysis of a colorectal cancer peripheral-glial program
description: Analysis scripts, fixed gene sets, intermediate summary tables, source data, and figure-generation code supporting a cross-platform study of a tumour-associated peripheral-glial transcriptional program in colorectal cancer.
